title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Kadana
desc: When Amar, an army officer, discovers that his wife and a reporter have been tortured by a corrupt politician and criminal duo, he resolves to fight them.

title: Yaare Neenu Cheluve
desc: A woman loses her bag which contains important documents and a man ends up finding it. Later, he sends it to her along with a letter which begins a romantic exchange amongst them.

title: G.O.A.T
desc: After a tragedy tears him apart from his wife, Gandhi, a former elite spy, is forced back into the field for a mission of the utmost importance.

title: Kousalya Supraja Rama
desc: Inspired by his father's values, Ram grows up to become a chauvinist with a rigid view of masculinity. However, a woman named Shivani begins to transform him into a better man.

title: Anaganaga Oka Raju
desc: In vibrant Gaurapuram, quirky Raju meets spirited Charulatha, sparking events. Their tale centers on a grand wedding, blending humor and family celebrations in this festive story.

title: Golisoda
desc: Four orphans working at a market in Bengaluru decide to make a name for themselves by opening a small eatery. However, chaos ensues when local goons set out to wreak havoc.
